channel.title: ThisWeek Desktop Updates
channel.description: Signed updates for the current ThisWeek desktop app.

item.description:
ThisWeek Desktop 0.1.4

Join meetings one minute early with notes ready.

  • Always-on-top Join & take notes panel one minute before a calendar event.
  • Pick workspace and space on the panel before joining.
  • Opens Google Meet (or Zoom/Teams) in your browser and starts recording.
  • Uses your selected calendars so the correct upcoming meeting is shown.
  • Ask Anything is centered across calendar, notes, and transcript.

ThisWeek Desktop 0.1.3

Ask Anything stays out of the way until you need it.

  • Collapse the Ask Anything conversation when the input loses focus.
  • Keep the floating input visible; reopen the thread by clicking into Ask anything.

ThisWeek Desktop 0.1.2

Ask questions about a meeting while it is still going.

  • Floating Ask anything bar between the live transcript and your notes.
  • Query what has been said so far during a live meeting — answers use the transcript as it grows.
  • Multi-turn chat that saves to the server and stays in sync with web note chat.
  • Desktop Bearer auth for note chat, so Ask anything works from the Mac app.
